posts.text:
In the wake of Seattle Link's line 1 & 2 connection, ridership has surged 43% compared to this time last year, hitting a new record high! 

Link moved 4.8M passengers in May, breaking last month's record by nearly 150k. It's now the busiest US light rail system, beating SF Muni

posts.text:
May US transit data is in today, & all of the 10 largest US rail networks are growing! SF is seeing a real boom, with ridership up 16% on Muni & 13% on BART

SEPTA (Philly, 8.7%) and PATH (NY/NJ, +6%) are also seeing strong growth, while MTS (San Diego, +0.6%) is the slowest🧵

posts.text:
New US trade data came in today, and even though I know the tariff exemption for data centers is gigantic, I'm still in awe of just how massive it's getting

A record $58B in computers came in tariff-free last month, nearly as big as the next 3 largest tariff carveouts combined
